newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares ease on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares ease on profit-taking.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased on Friday to end the week one percent lower in what traders decribed as a fall due to profit-taking following a growth of 6.13 percent over the previous week.

"I believe this week some investors wanted to cash in the profits after last week's jump while others wanted to bring prices down by selling in order to be able to buy at lower prices later," one trader said.
* The SBI index slipped 1.51 points or 0.1 pct to 1,552.66.

* Petrol trader Petrol was the most actively traded share, down 1.49 percent to 24,500 tolars on volume of 6,527 shares for total turnover of 159.5 million tolars. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
